name: Plate Coach Agent
description: A single-purpose nutrition agent: it identifies the dish in a meal photo with a fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 classifier, retrieves its nutrition facts, computes a deterministic 0-100 Healthy Score, and proposes small improvements whose projected scores are computed by code, never guessed by the LLM. It answers nutrition and what-if questions about meals and refuses anything outside that scope. General lifestyle information only, not medical advice.
target_audience: Health-conscious adults, people tracking their eating habits, nutrition students
tasks_capable_of_performing: Nutrition Profile Lookup (RAG over a nutrition database)
Meal Improvement Suggestions with Projected Scores
What-If Meal Simulations (add / remove / swap a food)
Weekly Meal Trend Summary (up to 20 photos)
examples_of_suitable_questions: How much protein is in sushi?
Is pizza high in saturated fat compared to pho?
What if I add a side salad to this meal?
What is a healthier swap for french fries?
